item.title: I replaced Homebrew and asdf with Devbox
item.description: In the last years, I used a combination of homebrew and asdf to manage some developer tools (eg. terraform, hadolint, ShellCheck, …) Recently I discovered devbox, a wrapper around NixOS package manager. First install Devbox: curl -fsSL https://get.jetify.com/devbox | bash Now, everytime I initialize a new project, instead of installing asdf plugins and declare it on .tool-versions, I just add the dependencies on devbox.json on the root of each project.
